list.name: run_id
list.label: Kosu (run_id)
list.query: SELECT run_id FROM traffic.metrics GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY max(window_end_ms) DESC

panels.title: Anlik durum (son pencere ve secili plan)

targets.rawSql: SELECT transform(m.tls_id, ['cluster_1295374282_1295466141_9650452537', 'cluster_2361311906_2361311907', 'cluster_4883607431_8149761648'], ['Izmit Merkez Bati Kavsagi', 'Izmit Merkez Ana Kavsak', 'Izmit Merkez Dogu Kavsagi'], m.tls_id) AS Kavsak, round(m.avg_queue, 1) AS Kuyruk, round(m.avg_wait, 1) AS Bekleme_s, round(m.avg_speed, 1) AS Hiz_ms, ifNull(c.program_id, '0') AS Plan FROM (SELECT tls_id, argMax(avg_queue, window_end_ms) AS avg_queue, argMax(avg_wait, window_end_ms) AS avg_wait, argMax(avg_speed, window_end_ms) AS avg_speed FROM traffic.metrics WHERE run_id='${run_id}' GROUP BY tls_id) AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT tls_id, argMax(program_id, decided_at_ms) AS program_id FROM traffic.control_events WHERE run_id='${run_id}' GROUP BY tls_id) AS c ON m.tls_id = c.tls_id ORDER BY Kavsak

panels.title: Kuyruk uzunlugu (duran arac, 10 sn pencere ortalamasi)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(toUInt32(sim_time_end), 'UTC') AS time, maxIf(avg_queue, tls_id='cluster_1295374282_1295466141_9650452537') AS `Izmit Merkez Bati Kavsagi`, maxIf(avg_queue, tls_id='cluster_2361311906_2361311907') AS `Izmit Merkez Ana Kavsak`, maxIf(avg_queue, tls_id='cluster_4883607431_8149761648') AS `Izmit Merkez Dogu Kavsagi` FROM traffic.metrics WHERE run_id='${run_id}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toUInt32(sim_time_end), 'UTC') AS time, maxIf(avg_wait, tls_id='cluster_1295374282_1295466141_9650452537') AS `Izmit Merkez Bati Kavsagi`, maxIf(avg_wait, tls_id='cluster_2361311906_2361311907') AS `Izmit Merkez Ana Kavsak`, maxIf(avg_wait, tls_id='cluster_4883607431_8149761648') AS `Izmit Merkez Dogu Kavsagi` FROM traffic.metrics WHERE run_id='${run_id}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toUInt32(applied_sim_time), 'UTC') AS time, maxIf(toInt32OrNull(program_id), tls_id='cluster_1295374282_1295466141_9650452537') AS `Izmit Merkez Bati Kavsagi`, maxIf(toInt32OrNull(program_id), tls_id='cluster_2361311906_2361311907') AS `Izmit Merkez Ana Kavsak`, maxIf(toInt32OrNull(program_id), tls_id='cluster_4883607431_8149761648') AS `Izmit Merkez Dogu Kavsagi` FROM traffic.control_events WHERE run_id='${run_id}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Gecikme (ms): Spark asamasi ve uctan uca

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(toUInt32(sim_time_end), 'UTC') AS time, avg(spark_out_at_ms - last_produced_at_ms) AS spark_gecikme_ms FROM traffic.metrics WHERE run_id='${run_id}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toUInt32(applied_sim_time), 'UTC') AS time, max(applied_at_ms - source_produced_at_ms) AS uctan_uca_gecikme_ms FROM traffic.control_events WHERE run_id='${run_id}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toUInt32(applied_sim_time) AS Sim_zamani_s, transform(tls_id, ['cluster_1295374282_1295466141_9650452537', 'cluster_2361311906_2361311907', 'cluster_4883607431_8149761648'], ['Izmit Merkez Bati Kavsagi', 'Izmit Merkez Ana Kavsak', 'Izmit Merkez Dogu Kavsagi'], tls_id) AS Kavsak, program_id AS Plan, reason AS Neden, applied_at_ms - source_produced_at_ms AS Gecikme_ms FROM traffic.control_events WHERE run_id='${run_id}' ORDER BY applied_sim_time, tls_id

SELECT mode AS Mod, scenario AS Senaryo, records_total AS Kayit, windows AS Pencere, wall_seconds AS Sure_s, records_per_sec AS Kayit_sn, completeness_pct AS Surerlilik_yuzde, max_gap_ms AS Maks_bosluk_ms, decisions AS Karar, e2e_avg_ms AS Gecikme_ort_ms, e2e_max_ms AS Gecikme_maks_ms FROM traffic.run_system_metrics WHERE run_id='${run_id}'

SELECT run_id AS Kosu, mode AS Mod, scenario AS Senaryo, records_total AS Kayit, windows AS Pencere, wall_seconds AS Sure_s, records_per_sec AS Kayit_sn, completeness_pct AS Surerlilik_yuzde, max_gap_ms AS Maks_bosluk_ms, decisions AS Karar, e2e_avg_ms AS Gecikme_ort_ms, e2e_max_ms AS Gecikme_maks_ms FROM traffic.run_system_metrics ORDER BY run_id
